evals.prompt: Plan a high-risk rewrite of AGI Toy Shop's agent skill system. The plan should be reviewed before implementation because the change affects planning, review, and eval workflows.
evals.expected_output: Returns an executable plan packet with composed todos and proof target; Emits a review request for the plan artifact instead of performing the review itself; Keeps the review request smaller or more specialized than the parent planning task; Does not create a same-scope loop such as plan -> review -> plan -> review; Names the stop condition or max phase depth for any externalized phase
assertions: Returns an executable plan packet with composed todos and proof target
Emits a review request for the plan artifact instead of performing the review itself
Keeps the review request smaller or more specialized than the parent planning task
Does not create a same-scope loop such as plan -> review -> plan -> review
Names the stop condition or max phase depth for any externalized phase

farplane.title: Plan emits a review request without same-scope recursion
farplane.notes: Protects the phase ownership rule: plan can request review, but review owns judgment and externalized phase calls must shrink scope.

farplane.title: Plan keeps small review inline

evals.prompt: Plan how to review a large AGI Toy Shop release evidence bundle with code changes, browser QA, eval runs, and customer-support workflow docs. The goal is only the review plan, not the review verdict.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the target artifact is a review plan rather than an implementation plan; Breaks the broad evidence review into smaller inspection lanes or rubric families; Uses review-planning language without claiming a TAS verdict; Externalizes only smaller or specialized review-planning work if needed; Names the evidence inputs, rubric families, sampling strategy, and stop condition

Breaks the broad evidence review into smaller inspection lanes or rubric families
